summary: kubernetes.core drops ansible-core below 2.14 and updates to the Python kubernetes library 24.2.0, with support for Kubernetes 1.24+.
questions: Which python kubernetes library version does kubernetes.core need?

answer_card.title: kubernetes.core requirements
answer_card.answer_md: kubernetes.core requires ansible-core 2.14+, the Python `kubernetes` library 24.2.0, and Kubernetes 1.24 or newer.
